cancellation_summary: Full price will be charged for cancellations, tour date changes, and “no shows” unless we receive advance notice as follows: One to five guests – 24 hours; Six or more guests – 48 hours; Private charters – 72 hours.
meeting_point: Major hotels and resorts in Kona and Waikoloa
accessibility: Our vehicles cannot accommodate wheelchairs, scooters, or walkers.
description: See rare black sand beaches, walk through a lava tube, visit famous Kona Coffee Farm and the magnificent Volcanoes National Park, finish the adventure with stargazing near Mauna Kea. Experience the Big Island’s most spectacular natural splendors on this small-group tour with a professional local guide sharing knowledge of the history, cultures, and geology of the island.
what_is_included: Guests are served a local-style picnic lunch and dinner at a restaurant along with assorted juices, snacks, and bottled water. In addition, all park entrance fees, jackets, and rain gear are also included.
itinerary:
- Visit a Kona Coffee Farm, stroll through orchards, learn about coffee harvesting, and enjoy a fresh cup of Kona coffee.

- Pass scenic views of Kealakekua Bay and South Point, then relax at Punaluʻu Black Sand Beach, home to Hawaii’s green sea turtles.

- Explore Hawaii Volcanoes National Park along the Chain of Craters Road, stopping at lava flow sites, steam vents, Thurston Lava Tube, and Kīlauea Iki and Halemaʻumaʻu Craters with expert narration.

- Enjoy a warm and delicious dinner at a restaurant near the Volcanoes National Park.

- End the evening with stargazing near Mauna Kea, viewing stars, planets, and galaxies as your guide shares Hawaiian sky legends.
highlight_description: See black sand beaches, visit a Kona Coffee Farm, and the Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, including Thurston Lava Tube and Kilauea Crater. Complete the adventure with stargazing near Mauna Kea.
check_in_details: We pick up from all resorts and hotels in Keauhou, Kona, Waikoloa, and the Kohala areas between 9:30 a.m. and 11:00 a.m. Actual pickup times vary depending on hotel location. The tour duration is approximately 12 hours.
what_to_bring: Wear comfortable clothing in layers as temperatures vary from warm to cool. Covered walking shoes are required.
restrictions: Guests should not be physically challenged or unable to walk short to moderate distances on uneven terrain. We sometimes encounter cool, wet, or muddy conditions. Ages 5 and older are required. Our vehicles cannot accommodate wheelchairs, scooters, or walkers.
faqs:
**How much hiking do we do?**
A: We will have a couple of easy hikes over a short distance on this tour. The total distance is about 1.5 miles

**Will we get to see active lava?**
A: Due to the dynamic nature of active volcanoes, lava viewing conditions change daily or even hourly. The best viewing of current eruptive activity is on our Twilight Volcano Tour. We will do our best to get you to the closest viewing area providing it is safe and legal.

**What's the difference between the Twilight Volcano Tour and Circle Island Tour?**
A: Both tours feature a Kona coffee farm, Punalu'u black sand beach, and Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park. The Circle Island Tour adds two waterfalls and Waipio Valley Lookout with about 1.5 hours in the national park, while the Twilight Volcano Tour offers about 3 hours in the national park, a restaurant dinner, and stargazing near Mauna Kea.
